findings.description: Product list prices change on every page load (e.g. Backpack showed $94.88, then $60.01, $40.73, $88.65 across reloads), so the displayed price is not stable and does not match the price used later.
repro: Observe every product price changes on each load

findings.description: Cart and checkout prices differ from the product list prices (Backpack listed at $94.88 or similar, but cart shows $29.99; Bike Light cart $9.99 vs list $53.73), so the order total shown at checkout does not match what the customer saw when adding items.
repro: Add the product to the cart and open the cart
Compare the cart price with the list price

findings.description: The Bolt T-Shirt price is shown as "$13.4" with one decimal place, while other prices show two decimals (e.g. $6.78); it should read $13.40 (also $64.9 on mobile).
repro: Read the Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt price

findings.description: Product card titles are misaligned: Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket are indented or shifted relative to the other card titles at 1280 px, and at 360 px the Fleece Jacket title is right-aligned and wraps unlike the others.
repro: Open /inventory.html at 1280 px and at 360 px

findings.description: On desktop the Add to cart button of the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card overflows the card's right border, unlike the other cards.
repro: Look at the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card's Add to cart button

findings.description: The cart icon in the header sits below the header bar line and is not vertically aligned with the menu icon and title, on desktop and mobile.
repro: Compare the cart icon position with the hamburger menu and the Swag Labs title

findings.description: The cart link's accessible name reads "Cart, 1 items" with incorrect plural grammar and does not match the singular count.
repro: Add one item to the cart
Inspect the cart link accessible name

notes: Tested login, inventory, sort, cart, checkout overview and completion, product detail, and a 360 px mobile inventory view. Not fully tested: keyboard focus styling, the burger menu on mobile, and the product detail page layout.

cost.notes: estimate from 28278 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0034
